description: Implement Gate B data and retrieval on top of FEAT-001: exact pinned Kaggle acquisition/loaders, merged deterministic retrieval and SFT artifacts, real strict preparation, BGE dense/hybrid/full indexes, reranking, and corpus-bound calibration. It depends on Gate A normalization, safety, CLI, and artifact activation.
steps: Expand /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/configs/datasets.yaml with all exact verified headers, canonical field maps, compact-JSON observed-header hashes, row expectations, licenses, archive/member hashes, and deterministic source/authentication/confidence rules for gpreda/medquad/1, akashkumarpr/ayurvedic-knowledge-dataset/1, and aliainaanraza/ayurveda-healthcare-dataset/2.

Implement /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/src/acharya/ingest/download.py around kaggle==2.2.4 versioned owner/slug/version calls, before/after version metadata comparison, secure staged extraction, exact hash validation, strict cache-only fallback, redacted failures, and a hard prohibition on rcratos/ayurveda-texts-english/1.

Extend loaders/pipeline and /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/training/prepare_sft.py to normalize, safety-filter, role-separate, dedupe, merge, reconcile, and deterministically split all eligible records with complete provenance, attribution, data card, counts, rejection, duplicate, token, and SHA-256 reports.

Run prepare-handoff --strict twice against the real three public datasets plus PDF. Preserve real ignored archives/artifacts and actual counts when successful; if access fails, write exact redacted blocker evidence, mark Gate B BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_DATA, and never synthesize a success while continuing other accessible work.

Implement locked BGE model acquisition/file hashes, dense and BM25 top-20 union scoring, RRF, all-candidate reranking, full/mvp_hybrid/bm25_only readiness semantics, atomic indexes, and answerable/adversarial threshold calibration without per-query BM25 maximum normalization; run fake mode tests and actual model/index work where access permits.
acceptance_criteria: Exact expected headers and header hashes are enforced by name/order; missing, renamed, reordered, or additional columns fail, and healthcare Decimal Confidence/Auth_Score plus Authentication Notes rules have deterministic rejection reasons.

The pinned Kaggle client sends configured dataset_version_number before/list/download/after operations, verifies immutable metadata and configured archive/member hashes, and uses only a hash-valid cache in strict fallback.
The mixed-rights rcratos archive is never downloaded, extracted, processed, or bundled.

A successful real preparation contributes retrieval rows from all three Kaggle sources and the PDF and emits nonempty train/validation/test JSONL with reconciled real counts, no split leakage, complete attribution and matching SHA256SUMS; otherwise Gate B is explicitly blocked with execution evidence.

Full mode retrieves 20 dense and 20 BM25 candidates, populates both scores for their union, reranks every union candidate, applies hash-bound zero-false-support calibration, and leaves prior active artifacts intact on failure.
Two strict cached preparations and index builds reproduce fingerprints/content hashes and never claim inaccessible external work.

Repeat the same strict prepare-handoff command, then run PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15 uv run --project /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild python -m acharya.cli verify-preparation --workspace /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild --strict

PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15 uv run --project /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild python -m acharya.cli index build --workspace /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild --retrieval-mode full

PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15 uv run --project /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild python -m acharya.cli evaluate --workspace /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild --retrieval-mode full --golden /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/eval/golden.jsonl --activate-calibration
blocked_reason: Gate B dataset_acquisition is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_DATA because Kaggle authentication was unavailable and no hash-valid cache existed for any selected archive; deterministic implementation and accessible model/retrieval execution are complete.
findings: Implemented FEAT-002 exact schema locks/loaders, secure version-aware Kaggle acquisition, deterministic merged retrieval/SFT preparation and reports, and bm25_only/mvp_hybrid/full retrieval with locked BGE acquisition, dense+BM25 top-20 union, raw lexical support, RRF, all-union reranking, atomic activation, and corpus/model/config-bound zero-false-support calibration. Verification: frozen retrieval install and uv lock check passed; Ruff passed; strict mypy passed for 27 source files; all 39 project tests passed (10 FEAT-002 targeted tests). All attempts truthfully failed authentication with cache_missing_or_invalid, so no dataset rows/downloads/preparation success are claimed. Ignored artifacts/gates/gate-b.json records all three IDs and versions as BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_DATA/dataset_acquisition; SHA-256 30ee25eb1c3a2a3da4b5602d7627df163a720769fb876465b520ce0de14ba100. rcratos/ayurveda-texts-english/1 was neither fetched nor opened and is hard-rejected. Accessible real model work succeeded: downloaded the exact pinned BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 revision (14 resolved files; aggregate a9ee48857dcfcf3247d32945182f62678669d24411baa2c798f340e03ac6f547) and BAAI/bge-reranker-base revision (10 resolved files; aggregate da37b6a380e8f69b0653cfddd86ee4e24e95a0f9123dcb7eee3a40e1ae6280a0), with trust_remote_code false and individual file hashes persisted in ignored index evidence. The actual PDF-bound full index was built repeatedly with identical fingerprint 974d3c8a9122d62c888eaaeb23b8aff0b493605623dd95f0d82ecf488a748d07 over corpus 8864cd8eb6f62409117ae857ca9308f1d7c1f2625291d041afa04f22e8f341f7 and 11 eligible documents; manifest SHA-256 60e5dcfa76c1c973258387720245a6fc2d27bbc390f546529ebca106e60f5554. Real full evaluation supported 1/1 answerable and 0/3 adversarial rows (zero false support), selecting dense 0.8, rerank 0.7, raw BM25 40.25814429932041, coverage 0.8; calibration artifact SHA-256 ec0e2b8b54ffcbc27f9c9b49439d25d07092f20e8a7c1c531777b32175d3f035. An actual service retrieval returned one cited full-mode answer with BM25 80.51628859864083, dense 0.9257956469328663, rerank 0.729885901817719, and no fallback warning. Gate A was rerun successfully after the retrieval changes. Later-step need: provide Kaggle authentication or exact hash-valid archives, rerun strict preparation twice to obtain real 16,412/1,000/10,000-row loader counts and deterministic merged SFT fingerprints, then rebuild/recalibrate full retrieval over that merged corpus; downstream handoff/bundle work must retain the dataset_acquisition blocked component until that succeeds.
